diagnosis.newTestFirstAttempt: One regression assertion incorrectly treated a missing /proc entry as a dead process. The local runtime exposes a child PID to kill(pid,0) without a corresponding /proc path. Diagnosis confirmed kill(pid,0)=true for the live sentinel while /proc returnedENOENT.
